aboutGame.title: What is Hide ur Base and Steal?
paragraphs: Hide ur Base and Steal is an intense Roblox simulation and multiplayer strategy game developed by Sutik x Tommy. In this game, your goal is to build and conceal your personal underground secret base, purchase valuable pets that generate continuous income, and defend your earnings from ambitious infiltrators across the server.

Beyond securing your own domain, the thrill comes from hunting down hidden base entrances set up by other players. Sneak through their defenses, grab high-tier pets straight from their vaults, and extract safely to grow your empire while taking advantage of rolling Server Luck boosts.

items.question: What is Hide ur Base and Steal on Roblox?
items.answer: Hide ur Base and Steal is a multiplayer simulation game on Roblox by Sutik x Tommy where players hide secret base entrances, collect cash-generating pets, and infiltrate other players bases to steal their pets.

items.question: How do I hide my base effectively in Hide ur Base and Steal?
items.answer: To hide your base effectively in Hide ur Base and Steal, place your entrance portal in obscure, elevated, or shadowed areas behind map props, and avoid revealing your location while entering.

items.question: How does stealing pets work in Hide ur Base and Steal?
items.answer: In Hide ur Base and Steal, you locate another player secret entrance portal, enter their subterranean bunker, grab an unguarded pet, and navigate back out to add it to your own base collection.

items.question: What is the Server Luck mechanic in Hide ur Base and Steal?
items.answer: Server Luck in Hide ur Base and Steal is a global server event where luck doubles every 10 minutes up to 32x or 64x before resetting every hour, providing massive boost windows for earning cash and rolling rare pets.
